description_for_human: Open and manage your personal link collection across Microsoft 365 and devices.
description_for_model: Use Personal Links when the signed-in user asks to see, open, or maintain their own reusable personal links or shortcuts, including requests to add, edit, delete, find, or reorder a saved link. The action renders the interactive Personal Links experience inline. Do not use it for general web search, a one-time URL open, browser favorites, organization-managed bookmarks, SharePoint navigation, or another person's links.
